# goslop text fixture — exception-type extraction feeding a failure counter:
# the handler accounts for the error and logs the first occurrence without
# swallowing (requestSpeedTest rnet_test.py:37 FP shape)
lang: python
file: type_counter.py
---
def worker(wid):
    local_errors = {}
    local_fail = 0
    try:
        resp = fetch(wid)
        local_ok += 1
    except Exception as e:
        name = type(e).__name__
        local_errors[name] += 1
        local_fail += 1
        if local_errors[name] == 1:
            log.error(f"Worker {wid} error: {e}")
    return local_fail, local_errors
